newsitem.title: USA: Burlington Northern grain railcar summary.
newsitem.headline: Burlington Northern grain railcar summary.

text.p: BNSF WILL MAKE AVAILABLE, ON A PERIODIC BASIS, DESCRIPTIVE INFORMATION CONCERNING ITS GRAIN CAR FLEET, CAR LOADINGS AND OPERATING PERFORMANCE. THE INFORMATION ON THIS SCORE CARD PERTAINS ONLY TO BURLINGTON NORTHERN SANTA FE CAR LOADING INFORMATION AT THIS TIME.
THE PERIODS DISPLAYED REPRESENT SUNDAY TO SATURDAY WEEKLY CYCLES.
AVERAGE DAILY C6 FLEET SIZE AND STATUS FOR WEEK ENDING:
C6 CARS STORED SUITABLE FOR GRAIN 4,933 5,484 5,166 4,962
C6 CARS STORED NOT SUITABLE FOR GRAIN 0 0 0 0
C6 FLEET PERFORMANCE STATISTICS FOR WEEK ENDING:
MONTHLY CAR LOADINGS APRIL MARCH FEBRUARY JANUARY
OUTSTANDING GRAIN CAR DEMAND THROUGH JUNE 30, 1997 28,872
(INCLUDES ORDERS AND PROJECTIONS FOR C6, C6X, COTS, UNIT AND SINGLE CAR ORDERS)
COT ACTIVITY - AS OF JUNE 05,1997 UNITS AND SINGLES, (ALL CORRIDORS)
OFFERED SOLD REMAINING OFFERED SOLD REMAINING
NOTE: BNSF CUSTOMERS DESIRING TO SUBMIT OT-5 REGISTRATIONS SHOULD CONTACT ROGER SPERRY'S OFFICE AT BURLINGTON NORTHERN SANTA FE, P O BOX 961034, FORT WORTH, TEXAS 76161-0034, PHONE (817) 352-1190.

NOTE: THESE STATISTICS REPRESENT CAR LOADINGS OF 75 GRAIN RELATED COMMODITIES IN 27 STATES AND 2 CANADIAN PROVINCES. STATISTICAL VARIANCES REFLECT VARIOUS DATA SOURCES AND SOME NUMBERS MAY BE SUSPECT DUE TO CONSOLIDATION OF BURLINGTON NORTHERN AND SANTA FE DATABASES UNTIL MID-YEAR 1997.
